instruction.text: Write a sequence using the following information.

atoms.a: In Khazin’s book, chapter 1 ends on page 17 and chapter 2 ends on page 34. Each chapter is the same length.

instruction.text: Write a sequence using the following information.

atoms.a: One day a blackberry bush has 33 berries on it. The next day a blackbird eats some berries and leaves 25 behind. The same blackbird comes each day and eats the same number of berries.
How many more days would it take for the bush to be bare?

instruction.text: Write a sequence using the following information.

atoms.a: A lock holds 140,000 litres of water. One minute after draining begins, there are 133,000 litres of water. The same amount of water is drained each minute.

instruction.text: Write a sequence using the following information.

atoms.a: A stamp collector begins her collection with 25 stamps. After another year she has 50. She collects the same number of stamps each year.
How many more years would it take for the collection to reach 300 stamps?

instruction.text: Write a sequence using the following information.

atoms.a: My little sister was 108cm last year but now she has grown to 117cm! She grows the same amount each year.
